spells/analyze-portal-4986.name: Analyze Portal
spells/analyze-portal-4986.effectSummary: Detects magical portals or gate effects after 1 round of studying an area and reveals their sizes and locations. Once a portal is found, each round of study can reveal, in order, its activation key, special activation circumstances, whether it is one-way or two-way, and then a 1-round glimpse of its destination; each property requires a caster-level check against DC 17 and can be retried on a later round. For unusual portals, a random portal reveals only that it is random and whether it can currently activate; a variable portal reveals only its current destination; a creature-only portal reveals where creatures go but not a separate equipment destination; and a malfunctioning portal reveals only that it malfunctions, not the malfunction type.

provenance.role: primary Expedition to Undermountain catalog record; effect text contains an explicit missing-content marker
complete 3.5 Analyze Portal printing used to restore the omitted unusual-portal mechanics
independent same-spell cross-check for unusual-portal mechanics

spells/anathema-274.name: Anathema
spells/anathema-274.effectSummary: Permanently severs the divine link between the caster's deity and a lower-level cleric, druid, ranger, paladin, or ordinary worshiper of the same faith, even across planes. Affected divine characters lose divine spellcasting and class-granted divine powers such as turning or commanding undead, healing, harming, smiting, shapechanging, and similar abilities. An ordinary worshiper is barred from the faith's services, and a subject who dies under the effect is denied entry to the deity's plane. Members of the faith must shun the subject, while clerics, paladins, druids, and rangers of that faith automatically recognize the anathema by sight. The effect lasts until lifted by the original caster, removed by a higher-level cleric of the same faith using atonement, or ended when the subject changes divine allegiance.

provenance.role: primary catalog record; source prose is silently truncated in the middle of the effect
Champions of Ruin p.28 complete spell text used to restore omitted mechanics

spells/arboreal-transformation-867.name: Arboreal Transformation
spells/arboreal-transformation-867.effectSummary: Transforms the subject into a Huge oak tree. For a number of days equal to caster level, the tree is animated as a treant that cannot animate other trees and serves the caster's commands; it can follow the caster or be left with a triggering phrase as with liveoak. When that duration expires, the subject becomes a normal permanent tree rooted where it stands if possible. A creature that succeeds on its Fortitude save is instead slowed for the spell's duration and returns to normal when that duration ends.

provenance.role: primary catalog record; effect prose is truncated/corrupted at the liveoak reference
complete same-spell 3.5 text used only to restore the omitted mechanics

spells/greater-aspect-of-the-deity-975.name: Aspect of the Deity, Greater
spells/greater-aspect-of-the-deity-975.effectSummary: Functions as lesser aspect of the deity but grants half-celestial or half-fiend qualities without their spell-like abilities, changes the caster's type to outsider for the duration, and still allows resurrection if slain. A good cleric gains feathered wings with flight at twice normal speed and good maneuverability, +1 natural armor, low-light vision, immunity to acid, cold, disease, and electricity, +4 racial on saves against poison, and ability bonuses of +4 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +2 Intelligence, +4 Wisdom, and +4 Charisma. An evil cleric gains batlike wings with flight at normal speed and average maneuverability, +1 natural armor, bite and claw attacks based on size, 60-foot darkvision, immunity to poison, resistance 20 to acid, cold, electricity, and fire, and ability bonuses of +4 Strength, +4 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +4 Intelligence, +4 Wisdom, and +2 Charisma.

provenance.role: primary catalog record; description is truncated mid-sentence before the good-cleric transformations
complete same-spell D&D Tools mirror used to restore omitted mechanics
Defenders of the Faith p.86 cross-check of the complete spell text

spells/blessing-of-the-snake-mother-1380.name: Blessing of the Snake Mother
spells/blessing-of-the-snake-mother-1380.effectSummary: Temporarily grants several yuan-ti tainted-one traits. The target gains the Alertness feat, +2 Constitution, and complete immunity to snake venom and yuan-ti poison. Its appearance becomes more feral and snakelike, and it counts as a yuan-ti for spells and other effects, including favored-enemy interactions and Ghostwalk rules that prevent yuan-ti from forming ghosts. The spell grants the caster no control over the target and is normally used on willing subjects.

spells/celebration-1646.name: Celebration
spells/celebration-1646.effectSummary: Affected creatures receive one Will save when the spell begins. The caster must perform a drinking song for at least 1 full round; intoxication then escalates by performance round: round 1 has no effect, round 2 imposes a -2 enhancement penalty to Dexterity, Intelligence, and Wisdom, round 3 makes the subject nauseated, and round 4 makes the subject helpless. Creatures entering the area after casting are not affected, and affected creatures need not remain in the area. The effects persist while the caster keeps performing; if performance stops, they no longer worsen and fade after 1 round per caster level.

provenance.role: primary catalog record; prose references a required intoxication table that is absent from the rebuilt page/export
Magic of Faerûn p.84 used to recover the omitted round-by-round intoxication table
independent sourcebook cross-check of the omitted table

spells/citys-might-3051.name: City's Might
spells/citys-might-3051.effectSummary: While within 100 feet of a qualifying community, grants enhancement bonuses to Strength and Constitution plus damage reduction based on settlement size: large town or smaller +2 Strength/Constitution and DR 2/adamantine; small city +4 and DR 4/adamantine; large city +6 and DR 6/adamantine; metropolis +10 and DR 10/adamantine. If cast more than 100 feet from a community it has no effect, and moving more than 100 feet from the community ends the spell immediately.

provenance.role: primary catalog identity, source, duration, range, community-distance rule, and statement that bonuses scale with community size; numeric scaling omitted
independent 3.5 rules implementation explicitly reproducing the City's Might settlement-size bonus table
independent 3.5 spell reference confirming City's Might as the Races of Destiny Str/Con enhancement plus adamantine-DR spell

spells/dweomer-of-transference-1140.name: Dweomer of Transference
spells/dweomer-of-transference-1140.effectSummary: Surrounds one willing psionic creature with a field that converts spells cast at it into temporary power points instead of their normal effects. Power gained by spell level is: 0→0, 1st→1, 2nd→2, 3rd→4, 4th→6, 5th→8, 6th→10, 7th→12, 8th→14, 9th→16. The spells must still be cast normally with their usual components and range requirements. Unspent temporary power points disappear after 1 hour.

provenance.role: primary catalog record; effect references a required spell-level-to-power-point table omitted from the rebuilt page
3.5 SRD copy used to restore the omitted power-point conversion table

spells/summon-undead-i-1343.name: Summon Undead I
spells/summon-undead-i-1343.effectSummary: Functions as summon monster I but summons an undead creature. This Ghostwalk printing's 1st-level Summon Undead list contains a Medium skeleton or a Small zombie. The chosen creature can change each casting, summoned undead do not count against undead-control Hit Dice limits, and summoning undead is always evil.

spells/abyssal-frenzy-1157.name: Abyssal Frenzy
spells/abyssal-frenzy-1157.effectSummary: Transforms the subject for the duration: land speed +30 feet, +3 enhancement natural armor, +2 profane Strength and Constitution, -2 Dexterity, 60-foot darkvision or +60 feet to existing darkvision, and two claw attacks if it lacked them. New claw base damage by target size is Fine 1d2, Diminutive 1d3, Tiny 1d4, Small 1d6, Medium 1d8, Large 2d6, Huge 2d8, Gargantuan 4d6, Colossal 2d8; existing claws instead increase one damage die type. Hitting one target with both claws rends for twice claw damage plus twice Strength modifier. The subject cannot communicate, cast spells, use spell-like abilities, activate magic items, or wield weapons other than natural weapons.

provenance.role: primary catalog record; required claw-damage-by-size table omitted

spells/summon-giants-1262.name: Summon Giants
spells/summon-giants-1262.effectSummary: Summons one selected giant group to act immediately and fight for the caster: three fiendish hill giants (CE), two celestial or fiendish stone giants (N), one fiendish frost giant (CE), or one fiendish fire giant (LE). If the caster speaks Giant, the summoned giants can be directed to withhold attacks, attack specific enemies, or perform other actions. They act normally on the last round and disappear at the end of their turns.

spells/weighed-in-the-balance-3501.name: Weighed In the Balance
spells/weighed-in-the-balance-3501.effectSummary: Affects creatures in the area according to the original Underdark alignment/life-status table. Living LG, CG, LE, or CE creatures are affected as inflict critical wounds; living NG, LN, CN, or NE creatures as inflict light wounds; living true-neutral creatures as cure critical wounds; and all undead as heal, which damages them as normal for that spell. A Will save negates the effect and spell resistance applies.

provenance.role: primary Underdark catalog record; required alignment/effect table omitted
Underdark sourcebook copy used to restore the original alignment/effect table

spells/giant-size-2111.name: Giant Size
spells/giant-size-2111.effectSummary: Changes the caster's body size according to caster level in this Oriental Adventures printing: levels 15–16 become Huge (20 ft.) with +16 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +4 Constitution, +3 natural armor, and -2 size modifier to AC/attacks; levels 17–18 become Gargantuan (40 ft.) with +24 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +8 Constitution, +7 natural armor, and -4 AC/attack modifier; levels 19–20 become Colossal (72 ft.) with +32 Strength, -2 Dexterity, +12 Constitution, +12 natural armor, and -8 AC/attack modifier. Only ordinary mundane clothing changes size with the caster.

provenance.role: primary Oriental Adventures catalog record; required caster-level/size adjustment table omitted
Oriental Adventures sourcebook copy used to restore the omitted size-adjustment table

spells/minute-form-2116.name: Minute Form
spells/minute-form-2116.effectSummary: Shrinks the caster according to caster level in this Oriental Adventures printing: levels 15–16 become Tiny (18 in.) with -8 Strength, +4 Dexterity, -2 Constitution, and +2 size modifier to AC/attacks; levels 17–18 become Diminutive (9 in.) with -10 Strength, +6 Dexterity, -2 Constitution, and +4 AC/attack modifier; levels 19–20 become Fine (3 in.) with -10 Strength, +8 Dexterity, -2 Constitution, and +8 AC/attack modifier. No ability score can be reduced below 1. Only ordinary mundane clothing changes size with the caster.

spells/detect-vestige-3444.name: Detect Vestige
spells/detect-vestige-3444.effectSummary: Detects auras of creatures currently bound to vestiges. Round 1 reveals presence or absence; round 2 reveals the number of vestige auras and the strongest aura; round 3 reveals each aura's strength and location, or direction if outside line of sight. Aura strength depends on the minimum effective binder level needed for the vestige: 1st–4th faint, 5th–9th moderate, 10th–14th strong, 15th+ overwhelming. Each round the cone can be redirected; 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, thin lead, or 3 feet of wood/dirt blocks detection.

spells/mighty-wallop-3106.name: Mighty Wallop
spells/mighty-wallop-3106.effectSummary: Increases one bludgeoning melee weapon's damage by one effective size category without changing its dimensions or weight. For a Small weapon the conversion is 1→1d2, 1d2→1d3, 1d3→1d4, 1d4→1d6, 1d6→1d8, 1d8→1d10, and 1d10→1d12. Medium or larger weapons use the normal increasing-weapon-damage-by-size table.

spells/plague-2995.name: Plague
spells/plague-2995.effectSummary: Immediately infects each failed-save target with one chosen disease, then forces additional saves every round instead of every day, always using plague's save DC. Disease damage is: blinding sickness 1d4 Strength, with another plague-DC Fortitude save against permanent blindness whenever 2+ Strength damage is taken; cackle fever 1d6 Wisdom; filth fever 1d3 Dexterity + 1d3 Constitution; mindfire 1d4 Intelligence; red ache 1d6 Strength; shakes 1d8 Dexterity; slimy doom 1d4 Constitution.

spells/crumble-1748.name: Crumble
spells/crumble-1748.effectSummary: Erodes one fabricated nonliving object or structure, including a construct, for 1d6 damage per caster level to a maximum of 15d6, ignoring hardness. Living creatures are unaffected. Maximum target size depends on caster level: up to 15th level Huge, 16th–18th Gargantuan, and 19th–20th Colossal. Casting on an object larger than the allowed size fails.

provenance.role: primary catalog record; effect text contains the damage and size-dependent rule but omits the actual caster-level size table
